title: Cross-cycle initiative tracker for cost reduction: batching, caching, quantization
creator: Asha Patel
description: Program-level ticket to coordinate cross-team work on unit-cost reduction across the inference stack. Focus areas: smarter batching heuristics, adaptive KV-prefix caching, and standardized quantization profiles. Goal: 25-30% effective token cost reduction across three pilot workloads (chat, summarization, embeddings) by end of Q2 2026 while keeping p95 latency regressions <10% and no quality regressions on held-out evals.
updates: 2026-02-16: Kickoff with Eng, Research, and DevEx. Agreed on three pilots: chat-short-turns, long-form summarization, and embeddings-heavy retrieval. Assigned ENG-2284 for batching prototype and ENG-2290 for cache infra changes.

2026-02-22: Research presented quantization matrix (int8/4-bit) trade-offs. Decided to focus first on post-training static quantization with fallback to FP16 for high-risk models. Follow-up: bench runs on A100 and T4 scheduled.
2026-03-01: PM review with console team to ensure rollout controls and per-route cost visibility. Console work item DES-142 created for rollout UI and cost impact surface.
2026-03-04: First batching prototype (ENG-2284) shows 12% token-cost reduction on chat pilot at 5% tail latency increase. Action: iterate on batching window policy and add KV-aware grouping.
2026-03-05: Identified a dependency on infra autoscaling (INF-334) to support bursty traffic with new batching. Raised to dependencies. Plan to schedule a joint sync next week.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot experiments demonstrate >=20% token-unit cost reduction on at least two of three pilots without customer-facing quality regressions.
Metrics dashboard tracks: tokens-per-request, cost-per-token, p50/p95/p99 latencies, model quality deltas on held-out prompts.
Rollout plan available in console with canary and automatic rollback on SLO breaches.
Runbook and incident playbook updated for any new failure modes introduced by batching or quantization.
Quantization profiles and TTLs documented and stored in model-catalog with version pins.
next_steps: Schedule joint infra/serving sync to unblock INF-334 (by 2026-03-12).
Run quantization bench matrix on A100/T4 and publish results to the team (owner: Research, due 2026-03-18).
Iterate batching policy to add KV-aware grouping and test on chat pilot (owner: ENG-2284, due 2026-03-22).
Create console canary toggle and instrumentation (owner: DES-142 + Console Eng, due 2026-03-29).
Collect quality evals for pilots and set threshold alerts in Optimize platform (owner: PM/Miguel, due 2026-04-05).
